answer: An identity is issued only after a TPM/SGX enclave produces a zero-knowledge attestation of measured code, hardware key, and bounded hardware-clock drift; the vault state tree commits keys, yarrow is its hash anchor, and the delta consensus contract verifies proofs. Forging requires compromising distinct enclave hardware or continuous physical silicon provisioning, while quadratic bonding curves O(N^2) and irreversible slashing make Sybil identities economically prohibitive.
